date_note: Date is the article's publication day; the page says the head of BSSN spoke on that Tuesday after a closed meeting with Komisi I of the DPR RI.
title: Indonesia's BSSN warns of a wave of hacker attacks across countries targeting banking
summary: Katadata reports that BSSN head Nugroho Sulistyo Budi warned of a wave of hacker attacks across countries, which the article says target banking, finance and public services. He said the state of cyberspace is currently not good and that digital transformation needs a strong cybersecurity foundation. He spoke after a closed meeting with parliament's Komisi I.
plain: Indonesia's cyber agency head warned of a wave of hacker attacks across countries; Katadata says they target banking, finance and public services.
exec: Katadata reports Indonesia's cyber agency head warning of an attack wave targeting banking, finance and public services, and urging stronger cybersecurity foundations.

validation.note: One publisher, Katadata, quoting the BSSN head's own statement; no BSSN page read.

review.note: attribution: Katadata does not clearly attribute sector list to BSSN head; now 'the article says'
